You fire a dart carrying a powerful tranquilizer at a creature within 90 feet. Roll 5d8; if the total exceeds the target's remaining hit points, it falls unconscious until the power ends, it takes damage, or another creature uses an action to rouse it. This power has no effect on droids or constructs.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level beyond 1st, rolling 5d8 separately for each.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
